title: PageCommandInterceptorDescriptor
description: Describes a JavaScript interceptor for a page-scoped Create, Update, or Delete command.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: page interceptors run in the context of the page that triggered the command. Define at most one page interceptor per command/type combination (`Create`/`Update`/`Delete` × `Pre`/`Post`/`Replace`). Use `entityExecutionOrder` to control ordering against the matching entity interceptor. Page scripts receive the same scripting context as entity interceptors, including page metadata on `context.commandArgs.pageName` and `context.commandArgs.page`. To block the command, assign `globalError = "message"`.

commandName.description: Entity command to intercept: Create, Update, or Delete.

type.description: Whether the script runs before, after, or instead of the command.

javascript.description: JavaScript code to execute. For Pre interceptors, set globalError to block the command.

entityExecutionOrder.description: Optional ordering relative to the matching entity interceptor. Defaults to EntityFirst when omitted. Not used for Replace interceptors.

examples.javascript: if (context.commandArgs.data['Name'] === 'BlockedOnPage') { globalError = 'This name is blocked on the customers page.'; }
if (context.commandArgs.data['Title'] === 'PageBlocked') { globalError = 'This title is blocked by the page interceptor.'; }
